title: ScriptMaterialiseRequest
description:
Ask for a standalone `.vpy` built from one script input.

The page supplies the draft script, not the stored one, so the export is the text the
user is looking at. A project and video pair adds the persisted scene table and effective
sequence configuration; without them the template export carries an empty scene table and
the defaults, because a template belongs to no video.

project_id.description: The video whose scenes and scratch directory the export carries, when there is one.

script.description: The Python source, exactly as the page would save it.

sequence_config.description: The sequence document the page has open; absent uses the saved effective document.

video_path.description: The source file the exported script should open when the page knows one.
